points: Oh how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day. When Galatians 5 says walk in the spirit and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh, this is what he is talking about: your mind stayed on the word all the day.
You get a craving for some tacos and you know you cannot get them until after work: you think about those tacos all day. Where is that same zeal for the word of God?

Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word. In other words, I stay up all night to consume your word. As a king, David had all his responsibilities during the day; he could not wait to get into his private chambers and get into the word, and sometimes he did not even sleep at night.

Some of us were like that in the beginning, when you first came in. And then, because you stopped nourishing yourself every day, you do not have that yearning anymore. And when it comes to the Bible, it is not the same food every day: you have prophecy, laws, examples, history, exhortation, adventure. It is a buffet; it is a cornucopia.

note.label: Daily Bread for a Dying Man

My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law. That is the retention.

note.label: Daily Bread for a Dying Man

points: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee. That is how you keep your defenses up: the word stays in your heart. It goes back to Galatians 5, walk in the spirit and you will not fulfil the flesh.
This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me. The word quickens. Remember quicken for the close.

note.label: Daily Bread for a Dying Man

points: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth. There is no private truth; the law is the truth.

note.label: In Vain Do They Worship Me! Religious Syncretism

points: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law. These are not just your bodily eyes; these are your spiritual eyes. We need to delve into the scriptures and meditate so we can behold the wondrous things out of God's law.
The wondrous thing out of God's commandments: he wants me to be like him. God gave law so that we can be like unto him.

note.label: Called to Magnify the Law: Lord Increase Our Faith

points: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes. Where is the meditation? In the statutes.

note.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet. The word is a lamp. The word is the knowledge. Wisdom and knowledge is the stability of the times. All these scriptures are saying the same thing.

And a light unto my path. And a light unto all the paths. This is why you have got to ignite. You have got to ignite that spirit, because now you are able to influence those around you. As we are all walking, we are all striving together in the commandments.

note.label: Ignite Your Influence

points: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

note.label: Ignite Your Influence

points: I am afflicted very much. David said, I am afflicted very much. Quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word. Change me, O Lord, according to your mercies. Allow me to repent and come back to the fold, according to your word. Because why? The Bible says he is a merciful God. Christianity has corrupted that saying. But the Lord is merciful. Do not take advantage of his mercy, because you do not know when that mercy is going to run out. The Lord said, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy. That one act could be the end of your mercy.

note.label: Ignite Your Influence

points: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments. And teach me thy judgments. When we learn the judgments, what are we supposed to be able to do with those things? It is supposed to be able to change us. We are learning, and then you are able to teach it.

note.label: Ignite Your Influence

points: My soul is continually in my hand. Because now we have been taught the judgments. Now your soul is in your hands. That light is in your hands. A lot of brothers say, oh, it is the Lord's will. No, the Bible says my soul is continually in my hand. My soul is continually based upon my decision-making. Do I want to give myself wholly to the word, or do I want to play hopscotch in this truth?
Yet do I not forget thy law. And we cannot forget the law.

note.label: Ignite Your Influence

points: Blessed are the undefiled in the way who walk in the law of the Most High. We have to walk in the law, because without it we are defiled. Blessed are they that keep His testimonies and seek Him with the whole heart, the whole mind.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thou hast commanded us to keep Thy precepts diligently. When you look at the word precept it means law, it means commandment, it means rule. That is what a precept is, so precept upon precept is talking about the word of the Most High, the scriptures, the law.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Once we depart from the precepts we are in the midst of sin. The prayer here is that our ways were directed to keep His statutes, so that we shall not be ashamed when we have respect unto all His commandments.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word. The word of the Most High cleanses our brains, our mind, cleaning the filth that is within our heart, which is actually the mind.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: With my whole heart have I sought Thee, so let me not wander from Thy commandments. Thy word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee. The word hidden in the heart is what keeps a man from sinning.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I will meditate in Thy precepts. We have to meditate on the word of the Most High day and night, the same thing said in Joshua 1:8, delighting in His statutes and not forgetting His word.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Deal bountifully with Thy servant, that I may live and keep Thy word. Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law. Our people's eyes are closed and shut to the truth of this Bible, and the only way we will see this truth is if we keep the laws of the Most High.

Once we keep the laws of the Most High our eyes start to open to the truth around us, to who we are, what is required of us, who our enemies are, and who the other nations are. But you have to be converted in the laws first.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I am a stranger in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me. Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from Thy commandments. His testimonies are the delight of the servant and his counselors even when princes sit and speak against him.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word. I have declared my ways and Thou heardest me; teach me Thy statutes. Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, so shall I talk of Thy wondrous works.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Remove from me the way of lying, and grant me Thy law graciously. We need to remove all the lying and hypocrisy around us, and that will mean removing yourself from people who love to lie and love to be in your ear to confuse you about the goal of eternal life.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I have chosen the way of truth; Thy judgments have I laid before me. I have stuck unto Thy testimonies; put me not to shame. I will run the way of Thy commandments when Thou shalt enlarge my heart.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Teach me, O Most High, the way of Thy statutes, and I shall keep it unto the end. Give me understanding, and I shall keep Thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart. Make me to go in the path of Thy commandments, for therein do I delight.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness. Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken Thou me in Thy way. Turn away my reproach which I fear, for Thy judgments are good.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness. Another word for precept is the law or the rules, and to be quickened means to be changed toward the righteousness of His commandments.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Let Thy mercies come unto me, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word. So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me, for I trust in Thy word. Take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for I have hoped in Thy judgments.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: So shall I keep Thy law continually for ever and ever. Our whole duty while we are on this earth is to keep the laws of the Most High, and as long as we have breath the law has dominion over us and is not done away with.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I will walk at liberty, for I seek Thy precepts. I will speak of Thy testimonies also before kings and will not be ashamed, because we have the wisdom of this Bible, not the wisdom of this world.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Remember the word unto Thy servant, upon which Thou hast caused me to hope. This is my comfort in my affliction, for Thy word hath quickened me. We get comfort in our afflictions from this Bible, because it is what changes us.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage. A pilgrimage is your walk, your journey in this truth through the straight gate, now learning the laws of the Most High and being reborn again. That walk should be our song, knowing we are the top nation and understanding why we went into slavery and how to come out.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thou art my portion, O Most High; I have said that I would keep Thy words. I entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be merciful unto me according to Thy word. I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I made haste, and delayed not to keep Thy commandments. The bands of the wicked have robbed me, but I have not forgotten Thy law. At midnight I will rise to give thanks because of Thy righteous judgments.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that keep Thy precepts. You have to be a companion, a friend, to those that keep the laws of the Most High; that is who your companions need to be.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O Most High, according unto Thy word. Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I have believed Thy commandments. Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now have I kept Thy word.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me Thy statutes. The proud have forged a lie against me, but I will keep Thy precepts with my whole heart. It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I might learn Thy statutes.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Sometimes it is good for us to be afflicted so we can come back and learn this Bible. Everyone has a different pilgrimage, and some of us fall or get corrected, but the question is whether you will get back up and keep doing what this Bible says. The law of His mouth is better than thousands of gold and silver, because you get wisdom, knowledge, and understanding of His word.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments. They that fear Thee will be glad when they see me, because I have hoped in Thy word. I know that Thy judgments are right, and that Thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Let Thy law be my delight. The law has to be a delight to us; it is not grievous, it is not hard to do, it should be a delight for us to do the laws of the Most High. Let the proud be ashamed, for they dealt perversely with me without a cause, but I will meditate in Thy precepts.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Let those that fear Thee turn unto me, and those that have known Thy testimonies. Let my heart be sound in Thy statutes, that I be not ashamed, sound in the wisdom of this Bible among the nations.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: My soul fainteth for Thy salvation, but I hope in Thy word. Mine eyes fail for Thy word, saying, When wilt Thou comfort me? For I am become like a bottle in the smoke, yet do I not forget Thy statutes.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after Thy law. The pits are traps set by the proud, the throne of iniquity which is America, the pinnacle of sin, where once you go out your doors sin is everywhere. Are you going to have fellowship with that? The answer should be no.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: They had almost consumed me upon earth, but I forsook not Thy precepts. Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, so shall I keep the testimony of Thy mouth. The mischief is framed by law, giving rights to sodomites and signing all kinds of wickedness, but the Most High is our defense.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: For ever, O Most High, Thy word is settled in heaven. Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth. This word has been here from the beginning and endures for ever.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction. The law has to be our delight, because we could perish in our affliction without it. I will never forget Thy precepts, for with them Thou hast quickened me.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I am Thine, save me, for I have sought Thy precepts. The wicked have waited for me to destroy me, but I will consider Thy testimonies. I have seen an end of all perfection, but Thy commandment is exceeding broad.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: O how love I Thy law! It is my meditation all the day. The law has to be our meditation, so when you get angry, happy, or sad, go to the Bible and meditate on what you are doing.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thou through Thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies, for they are ever with me. I have more understanding than all my teachers, for Thy testimonies are my meditation. I understand more than the ancients, because I keep Thy precepts.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep Thy word. I have not departed from Thy judgments, for Thou hast taught me. How sweet are Thy words unto my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth. Through Thy precepts I get understanding, therefore I hate every false way.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path. This is the Bible; you start getting understanding, the word that is the light, the same thing said in Proverbs 6:23, which is the laws of the Most High.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep Thy righteous judgments. I am afflicted very much; quicken me, O Most High, according unto Thy word. My soul is continually in my hand, in danger, yet do I not forget Thy law.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I erred not from Thy precepts. Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever, for they are the rejoicing of my heart. I have inclined mine heart to perform Thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I hate vain thoughts, but Thy law do I love. Vain thoughts are being double minded, so a man hates the double mind but loves the law. Thou art my hiding place and my shield; I hope in Thy word. The hiding place is protection.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Depart from me, ye evildoers, for I will keep the commandments of my God. Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live, and let me not be ashamed of my hope. Hold Thou me up, and I shall be safe.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from Thy statutes, for their deceit is falsehood. Those that err from this Bible, their deceit is falsehood, which is why we have to hate every false way. My flesh trembleth for fear of Thee, and I am afraid of Thy judgments.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I have done judgment and justice; leave me not to mine oppressors. Be surety for Thy servant for good; let not the proud oppress me. Mine eyes fail for Thy salvation, and for the word of Thy righteousness.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Deal with Thy servant according unto Thy mercy, and teach me Thy statutes. I am Thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies. It is time for the Most High to work, for they have made void His law.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Therefore I love Thy commandments above gold, yea, above fine gold. Therefore I esteem all Thy precepts concerning all things to be right, and I hate every false way. You have to esteem all the laws of the Most High above everything and hate every falsehood.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thy testimonies are wonderful, therefore doth my soul keep them. The entrance of Thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple. The light gives us understanding, the same as verse 105, that the word is the lamp and the light.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Order my steps in Thy word, and let not any iniquity have dominion over me. Deliver me from the oppression of man, so will I keep Thy precepts.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant, and teach me Thy statutes. Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not Thy law.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Righteous art Thou, O Most High, and upright are Thy judgments. Thy testimonies that Thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful. My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten Thy words.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thy word is very pure, therefore Thy servant loveth it. The word is pure, undefiled. I am small and despised, yet do not I forget Thy precepts. Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is the truth.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: The laws of the Most High are everlasting and are the truth, the truth of who we are and what will set us free.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Most High. I will keep Thy statutes. I cried unto Thee; save me, and I shall keep Thy testimonies. I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried; I hoped in Thy word.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in Thy word. Hear my voice according unto Thy lovingkindness; O Most High, quicken me according to Thy judgment. They draw nigh that follow after mischief; they are far from Thy law.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Thou art near, O Most High, and all Thy commandments are truth. Concerning Thy testimonies, I have known of old that Thou hast founded them for ever.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me, for I do not forget Thy law. Plead my cause, and deliver me; quicken me according to Thy word. Salvation is far from the wicked, for they seek not Thy statutes.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Salvation is very far from the wicked because evil pursues them; they have no rest in their wicked ways, no peace, whether among the wicked of our people or among the wicked of the nations. Great are Thy tender mercies, O Most High; quicken me according to Thy judgments.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies, yet do I not decline from Thy testimonies. Thy word is true from the beginning, and every one of Thy righteous judgments endureth for ever. This word was here before anything, before the Book of the Dead, before the Koran, all that other garbage.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart standeth in awe of Thy word. I rejoice at Thy word, as one that findeth great spoil. I hate and abhor lying, but Thy law do I love, hating all the falsehood and backbiting against us.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Seven times a day do I praise Thee because of Thy righteous judgments. Great peace have they which love Thy law, and nothing shall offend them. Sometimes we do get offended, but that is part of our pilgrimage, and repentance is a two part step of confessing and forsaking, seeking counsel from leadership rather than covering our sins.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Lord, I have hoped for Thy salvation, and done Thy commandments. My soul hath kept Thy testimonies, and I love them exceedingly. I have kept Thy precepts and Thy testimonies, for all my ways are before Thee.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Let my cry come near before Thee, O Most High; give me understanding according to Thy word. Let my supplication come before Thee; deliver me according to Thy word. My lips shall utter praise, when Thou hast taught me Thy statutes.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: My tongue shall speak of Thy word, for all Thy commandments are righteousness. Let Thine hand help me, for I have chosen Thy precepts. I have longed for Thy salvation, O Most High, and Thy law is my delight.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

points: Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee, and let Thy judgments help me. I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant, for I do not forget Thy commandments. The lost sheep is the house of Israel, the people who go astray and must seek the face of the Most High early and follow this Bible, fleeing the strange doctrines.
